title: What costroid merged --dry-run prints for one fact, version 0.1
description: One merge fact costroid merged would send: its id and the document. merged --dry-run prints one such object a line and sends nothing.

merge_id.description: The fact's id: the repository's id and the pull request's number.

document.description: The document merged would send for the fact. docs/export.md shows one.
